savedDesignSource.purpose: Use #color-03 when converting the approved logo back to SVG later.

rules: Use assets/brand/official/hotelngo-logo-web.png in website headers, footers, login screens, and backoffice shells.
Display it at 126px in the desktop header and preserve the 504:138 ratio.
Do not reconstruct the logo with HTML text, web fonts, or CSS shapes.
Keep the saved n-color-types v10 HTML unchanged for future SVG work.
Do not overwrite the saved HTML source or the approved web PNG without a new explicit approval.
